cases.question: 总GMV是多少
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid'

cases.question: 各地区的GMV
cases.expected_sql: SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY r.region_name

cases.question: 各品类的销售额
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.category

cases.question: 各品类销量
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.category

cases.question: 一共多少单
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid'

cases.question: 每个地区的订单数
cases.expected_sql: SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY r.region_name

cases.question: 整体客单价
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid'

cases.question: 各品类的客单价
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.category

cases.question: 退款率是多少
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 4) FROM orders o

cases.question: 各品牌的销售额
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.brand, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.brand

cases.question: 华东地区的GMV
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND r.region_name = '华东'

cases.question: 华南有多少单
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND r.region_name = '华南'

cases.question: 家电品类的成交额
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND p.category = '家电'

cases.question: 上个月的GMV
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= date('now','start of month','-1 month') AND o.order_date < date('now','start of month')

cases.question: 这个月多少单
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= date('now','start of month')

cases.question: 今年各月份GMV
cases.expected_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7), ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= date('now','start of year') GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7)

cases.question: 每月销量
cases.expected_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7), ROUND(SUM(i.quantity), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7)

cases.question: 各商品销量排名
